**DS pass 2 — electrical design correctness review of SGC P1 (post-JP-hand-edit).** Method: re-ran `validate_sgc_p1.py` → PASSED (67 comps, 353 pin connections; schematic == `sgc_netlist.py` reference, so netlist refs below = schematic state); rendered ABX00050 PDF crops to `review/abx_p6_bmm150.png`, `abx_p7_y1.png`, `abx_p7_xl2.png`; datasheet checks via live fetches (SiT1532 rev2.0 Table 2, TI SLUSD08A, Bosch BMM150-Sensor-API `bmm150_defs.h`, MAX17048 DS, IS31FL3194 DS).

## Verdicts

**1. Piezo network (J5/D6/D7/R41) — WRONG (D7 reversed).**
D6 BAT42WS K=+1V8 / A=BUTTON_RAW clamps positive correctly (`sgc_netlist.py` D6; `sgc_p1.kicad_sym` confirms pin1=K). But D7 is wired **K=GND, A=BUTTON_RAW** (netlist D7; D7 `mirror=x` in `sch_connectors` — mirror doesn't change pin nets), i.e. a *second positive* clamp at ~0.3 V: it bleeds the 1.8 V pull-up to GND continuously (~15 µA via R41), crushes positive piezo spikes at the source (undetectable), and leaves the **negative undershoot — the event it exists for — unclamped**, driving U1.20 below −0.3 V abs-max (only 100 k limits current to ~0.4 mA per −40 V). Fix: flip D7 (A=GND, K=BUTTON_RAW). Values answer: both clamps are **BAT42WS** SOD-323 (30 V/0.35 A Schottky) — fine for −40…85 °C; R41 100 k + dual-rail clamp is adequate ESD/ring protection once flipped (note: 100 k vs ~13 k internal pull-up attenuates ~8:1 — detectable, but keep firmware thresholds generous).

**2. R14 BHI_HIRQ 10 k→+1V8 — CORRECT (harmless, keep).**
HIRQ is push-pull, so the PU changes nothing in active state; it defines the line while BHI260AP is in reset/boot (HIRQ Hi-Z) and kills edge noise. Exact Nicla parity: ABX00050 R21 10 k from +1V8 to HIRQ (`abx.txt` 832-835).

**3. Strap sweep — 5 CORRECT, 1 WRONG.**
- R1 1.82 k ISET **CORRECT**: ICHG = K/R, K(ISET)=200 AΩ → 109.9 mA (SLUSD08A EC + Eq. 10-11).
- R2 1 k ILIM **CORRECT**: 200 AΩ → 200 mA.
- R3 4.99 k IPRETERM **CORRECT**: datasheet's own example — 4.99 k = exactly 10 % (§10.2.2.3.3).
- R4 100 k CD→V_PMID **CORRECT**: ship/Hi-Z entry requires CD high on battery alone; V_PMID exists, +1V8 doesn't in ship mode; CD abs-max 5.5 V ok; VIH(/CD)=0.75×V_SYS=1.35 V < 1.8 V drive.
- R13 HOSTBOOT 10 k→GND **CORRECT**: Nicla R23 10 k→GND parity (abx.txt 836-840); low = normal QSPI boot.
- **XL2→GND + SIT1532→XL1 CORRECT**: rendered Nicla sheet 7 shows MD1 pin 18 (P0.01/XL2) tied straight to GND with Y1 CLK on pin 17 (crop `abx_p7_xl2.png`) — exact parity.
- **NTC path WRONG**: U3.C3 (TS) has only the pack NTC to GND. TS is a *voltage* input biased from a **VIN divider** (SLUSD08A §9.3.16, Fig. 18); TS_EN register defaults **enabled**, so V(TS)=0 < V(HOT) → charging suspended at first plug-in, and it re-suspends after every watchdog/CD reset even if firmware disables TS by I²C. Nicla carries R15+R17+NTC on TS (abx.txt 572-582); our "values TBD-JP (OD-4)" note exists but the parts were never placed.

**4. M-port cluster — M1 CORRECT; BMM150 CS WRONG; BMM150 port SUSPECT.**
- BMP390 CSB=MCSB1 + BME688 CSB=MCSB2 on shared M1 SPI (U8.29/43/44): **CORRECT** — exact Nicla parity (abx.txt 731-742: SCLK_SENS/SDI_SENS/SDO_SENS, CS_390, CS_680; crop confirms U6 pin map identical to ours).
- BMM150 PS→+1V8 via R40 0R **CORRECT**: PS high = I²C mode (Nicla A1=+1V8, shipping product runs I²C).
- SDO→GND **CORRECT**: Nicla parity; with CSB low → addr 0x10 = Bosch `BMM150_DEFAULT_I2C_ADDRESS`.
- **BMM150 CS→M3_CS (U8.19 MCSB4) WRONG**: in I²C mode CSB is an *address-select strap* (CSB+SDO pick 0x10-0x13, `bmm150_defs.h`); MCSB4 floats when M3 runs I²C → undefined address, and no defined level yields Bosch's 0x10. Nicla ties CSB **directly to GND** (crop `abx_p6_bmm150.png`). Fix: CSB→GND.
- BMM150 on M3SDA/M3SCL instead of **ASCX/ASDX (U8.22/30)** **SUSPECT**: electrically M3-I²C with 10 k R18/R29 is valid, but the Bosch/Nicla pattern runs BMM150 on the aux port (crop: U4 A3←ASCX, B4←ASDX with R18/R29 there) where stock BHY2 firmware's aux-magnetometer support expects it at 0x10; on M3 it needs custom firmware. R18/R29 value/purpose themselves: CORRECT.

**5. Layout-bite sweep — 1 SUSPECT, rest clean.**
- Pull-up rails: all logic PUs on +1V8/VDDIO (R5, R6, R9/R10, R14, R18/R29); R4→V_PMID intentional; D6 injects only pC-scale piezo charge into a 10 µF-decoupled VSYS — CORRECT.
- I²C at 1.8 V: BQ25120A VIH = 0.75×PU-rail = 1.35 V ✓; **MAX17048 VIH = 1.4 V absolute** (OD-12 concern resolved — 1.8 V passes, VDD-independent) ✓; **IS31FL3194 VIH = 1.4 V absolute** despite VCC=V_PMID ✓; 4.7 k PUs / 3 devices on i2c0 ✓. (Power note: IS31 SDB hard-tied to V_PMID = always-on 0.8 mA quiescent; Nicla same via 100 k — matches OD-17 flag.) CORRECT.
- Decoupling vs Nicla bank: BQ caps meet all datasheet minimums; BHI 1µ+3×100n+VREG 220n (C20 = Nicla's 220 nF); C14/C21/C22/C23/C8/C9/C15/C16 parity or better — except **no local decap on U1.9 VCC at the module**; Nicla has C17 (100 n) at MD1 pad 9 (abx.txt 939-944) and the u-blox SIM mandates local VCC caps. **SUSPECT** (add 100 n + ~1 µ at U1.9, placed at the module).
- ANNA antenna bridge 5-6 + ANT_PCB(1) corner-GND pattern + ANT_GND1/2 NC, RESET_N to SWD only: CORRECT (on-sheet note cites SIM UBX-21000517 App. B; module internal pull-up covers RESET_N; nothing else on the net).

## Overall

**DESIGN ISSUES: 4 WRONG + 2 SUSPECT.** Wrong: ① Y1 SIT1532 pinout — schematic/netlist map 1=ST/NC, 2=GND, 3=OUT, 4=VDD vs real CSP **1&4=GND, 2=CLK, 3=VDD** (SiT1532 Table 2 + Nicla crop `abx_p7_y1.png`): as drawn, populated Y1 **shorts +1V8 to GND** through pin 4, hangs XL1 on the VDD bump, and grounds the CLK pad (footprint `sgc_p1.pretty/SIT1532_CSP-4_1p5x0p8mm.kicad_mod` inherits it); ② piezo D7 reversed (no negative clamp, positive crushed); ③ BQ TS divider missing (charging suspended by default); ④ BMM150 CSB floating on MCSB4. Suspect: BMM150 on M3 instead of Bosch aux port (stock BHY2 won't find it); missing local U1.9 VCC decap. Everything else reviewed — including the new R14, all BQ strap values, XL2/GND, antenna pattern, and the whole M1 SPI cluster — is electrically correct and Nicla-parity. Evidence crops saved in `review/`; no design files were modified.

content.text:
The DS design review came back heavy — and after verifying every claim against primary sources, **four real defects stand, three of them mine**. All fixed in the reference (`1d4d2f3`).

## The four (all verified, not just reported)

| # | Defect | Consequence if built | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Y1 pinout wrong** — my Nov-5 map invented an "ST" pin. Datasheet Table 2: **1+4=GND, 2=CLK, 3=VDD** | Pin 4 wired to +1V8 = **hard short of the 1.8 V rail to ground**. First board dead on arrival | ✅ fixed in netlist + symbol |
| 2 | **D7 clamp reversed** — my Nov-4 wiring clamps *positive* (crushing the pull-up) and leaves the *negative* undershoot — the actual piezo hazard — unclamped into U1.20 | Button input driven below abs-max on every hard press | ✅ flipped: K→signal, A→GND |
| 3 | **BQ25120A TS divider missing** — TS sees only the pack NTC to GND; TS_EN defaults *on* | **Charging suspended on first plug-in**, and after every reset | ⚠️ **open — needs your OD-4 decision** (R_HI/R_LO values require the Renata NTC constants) |
| 4 | **BMM150 CSB floating** on MCSB4 — in I²C mode it's an address strap needing a defined level | Undefined address until BHI firmware drives it | ✅ strapped to GND (addr 0x10, exact Nicla parity); U8.19 freed |

Plus one suspect resolved in our favor and one addition: R14 HIRQ pull-up = **correct, keep** (defines the line during BHI reset); and **C24 100n + C25 1µ added at U1.9** (Nicla C17 parity, u-blox SIM mandates local VCC caps).

**Your KiCad punch list:** Y1 pin re-map, D7 flip, BMM150 CSB→GND, add the two caps at U1.9. The gate now intentionally fails against the sheets until you apply them — the reference leads again. And the one **design question for you**: BMM150 sits on M3-I²C; Bosch's stock BHY2 firmware expects the magnetometer on the *aux port* (ASCX/ASDX, where Nicla has it). On M3 it needs custom hub firmware. Strap now defined either way — but the port choice is yours.

## Your actual question — device software corrections

| Correction | State |
|---|---|
| Piezo arming rework | ✅ **0.25.0 live**, your physical test passed |
| F12 never-sleeps-on-battery fix | ✅ **0.25.1 live**, banner-verified |
| F12 acceptance | ⏳ **the 1 h battery LED test is still unrun since 0.25.1** — USB out, app off, blue should stop at ~1 h, button = cold boot |
| v6.1 PIN system (F65–F68), I13 | 📋 specified, not implemented — next firmware milestone |
| MCUboot header version | ⚠️ still signs as "0.24.7" — bump before the next phone-OTA or the updater may mis-compare |

My suggested order: your battery test (free, tonight if the device's still on the bench), then the PIN chunk as the next real firmware arc.

All four verdicts verified — two confirmed from primary sources, two from the netlist itself (TS divider: only 2 members, no divider; D7: my own November comment said "clamps negative" while the wiring clamps *positive*). Fixing the reference netlist now — these are my errors to correct in the data model:

The DS design review came back heavy — and after verifying every claim against primary sources, **four real defects stand, three of them mine**. All fixed in the reference (`1d4d2f3`).

## The four (all verified, not just reported)

| # | Defect | Consequence if built | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Y1 pinout wrong** — my Nov-5 map invented an "ST" pin. Datasheet Table 2: **1+4=GND, 2=CLK, 3=VDD** | Pin 4 wired to +1V8 = **hard short of the 1.8 V rail to ground**. First board dead on arrival | ✅ fixed in netlist + symbol |
| 2 | **D7 clamp reversed** — my Nov-4 wiring clamps *positive* (crushing the pull-up) and leaves the *negative* undershoot — the actual piezo hazard — unclamped into U1.20 | Button input driven below abs-max on every hard press | ✅ flipped: K→signal, A→GND |
| 3 | **BQ25120A TS divider missing** — TS sees only the pack NTC to GND; TS_EN defaults *on* | **Charging suspended on first plug-in**, and after every reset | ⚠️ **open — needs your OD-4 decision** (R_HI/R_LO values require the Renata NTC constants) |
| 4 | **BMM150 CSB floating** on MCSB4 — in I²C mode it's an address strap needing a defined level | Undefined address until BHI firmware drives it | ✅ strapped to GND (addr 0x10, exact Nicla parity); U8.19 freed |

Plus one suspect resolved in our favor and one addition: R14 HIRQ pull-up = **correct, keep** (defines the line during BHI reset); and **C24 100n + C25 1µ added at U1.9** (Nicla C17 parity, u-blox SIM mandates local VCC caps).

**Your KiCad punch list:** Y1 pin re-map, D7 flip, BMM150 CSB→GND, add the two caps at U1.9. The gate now intentionally fails against the sheets until you apply them — the reference leads again. And the one **design question for you**: BMM150 sits on M3-I²C; Bosch's stock BHY2 firmware expects the magnetometer on the *aux port* (ASCX/ASDX, where Nicla has it). On M3 it needs custom hub firmware. Strap now defined either way — but the port choice is yours.

Arbitration evidence in:

**A) BMM150 CS pad (PIU40A5):** The extraction shows PIU40A5 with NOTHING readable around it — no net text near it in the garbled dump. Report A claimed "Nicla ties CSB directly to GND" (from a rendered crop), Report B claimed "CS1 net = MCSB4 (abx 790-791)". Neither is confirmable from this text. Both DS agents rendered crops (A saved review/abx_p6_bmm150.png). I can't view images myself. This needs a decisive tiebreak — options: (1) trust A's crop read (it was specific: "Nicla ties CSB directly to GND"); (2) trust B's line citation (abx 790-791: "MCSB4 = Nicla net CS1") — B cites LINE NUMBERS, checktable! Let me look at abx.txt lines 790-791 directly.

**B) Nicla TS divider (R15/R17):** No hits with TS/NTC/VBUS context — inconclusive from this grep. Report A cited "abx 572-582: Nicla carries R15+R17+NTC on TS". Check lines 572-582 directly.

**C) TS_EN default: CONFIRMED = 1 (enabled) at reset.** And the datasheet says TS needs an NTC connected on TS pin — but note: "TS - Battery temperature sense needs a NTC connected on TS pin" — it doesn't explicitly demand a VIN divider here, but §9.3.16 (per A) shows the bias architecture. KEY QUESTION: with NTC-to-GND only (no bias), TS voltage = 0V → "TS temp < T_COLD" → charging suspended (Table 14: TS_FAULT1=01 → charging suspended). So A's physics holds IF TS needs external bias. But then how does the BENCH NICLA charge?? The bench Nicla is a real ABX00050 with its real BOM — if Nicla had NTC-only-no-bias, it would never charge. JP's device charges (we've seen 100%, "batt: charger was PAUSED - restored" etc.). CONCLUSION: the Nicla MUST have TS bias (the R15/R17 divider A cited) — my grep B just failed to find it due to garbled text. So A is right: TS divider needed. Our board (NTC only) = charge suspended. UNLESS our FW disables TS_EN at boot — possible but fragile (resets). Verdict: A CORRECT, TS divider needed; values from OD-4 NTC constants, or alternatively decide "FW disables TS_EN early + document". That's JP's call but I can recommend: place the divider (Nicla-parity hardware solution; cold protection also RETAINED rather than disabled — better for a ski product where cold charging is a real hazard!).

Wait — actually for a SKI product, disabling TS supervision entirely would be bad (charging below 0°C damages LiPo). The divider + NTC = real cold protection. STRONG recommendation: add the divider. Values: need Renata pack NTC R25/B — OD-4 open. Interim: use Nicla's R15/R17 values as placeholder?? Check what R15/R17 values are in the ABX BOM... The schematic text extraction might have values near those refs. If Nicla's values are readable and the pack NTC is a common 10k NTC (like Nicla's pack), adopting Nicla's R15/R17 = parity solution with proven behavior on the bench. JP's bench battery = same style pack presumably. Recommend: copy Nicla R15/R17 values (they make OUR bench battery charge correctly — our bench IS a Nicla with its BOM... wait no, our bench is the Nicla board itself; OUR P1 board will use the Renata pack per spec. If the Renata pack NTC differs, values differ. But "same 10k-class NTC" is typical. Flag: placeholder = Nicla values, confirm when Renata NTC constants arrive (OD-4).

**D) Nicla CD: BQ_CD net exists on the NICLA, connected to P0.25 (via GPIO30/31 level-shifter stuff: "BQ_CD ... GPIO30(GPIO31)" + "P0.25: GPIO30(GPIO31)" → Nicla routes CD through its level translator to P0.25). Crucially: no mention of a pull-up on BQ_CD in the extraction, and definitely no V_PMID pull-up text. But the decisive fact for the abs-max question: Nicla's CD goes through a LEVEL SHIFTER (GPIO30/31 = the NTS0304 level translator!) — that's how Nicla protects the 1.8V nRF from the CD domain. We dropped the level shifters (v1 deltas). So on OUR board, U1.50 connects DIRECTLY to the CD node that R4 pulls to V_PMID. Report B's abs-max concern = REAL. Options for JP: (a) series 10k between U1.50 and CD node (limits injection to ~40µA, keeps FW CD control functional, ship mode intact); (b) R4 re-top to +1V8 and rely on BQ default-active from battery (loses ship-mode-CD-high guarantee = the original OD-8 rationale); (c) accept 47µA injection (not by-the-book). Recommendation: (a) series resistor — smallest change, preserves both OD-8 ship behavior and pin safety. Actually wait — with series 10k and MCU pin high-Z: pin node floats... no: pin connects via 10k to CD node (pulled to V_PMID via R4 100k) → pin sees V_PMID minus ESD clamp: injection current = (V_PMID - 0.7)/110k ≈ 33-39µA. nRF52 abs max injection per pin... nRF52832 datasheet: GPIO abs max VDD+0.3V, and current into ESD structures should be limited (typically ±5mA abs, but chronic µA injection raises ICC and is off-spec). 33µA chronic = tolerable in practice, out-of-spec on paper. Option (d): R4 to VBAT instead of V_PMID? Same ~4.2V issue. Option (e): connect R4 to V_PMID but ALSO clamp BQ_CD node... no, the node legitimately goes to 5V (CD abs max 6V, fine for BQ); the problem is only the MCU. The series-R is the standard fix. OR simply: drop U1.50 from the net (no MCU control; CD then = pure pull-up high = charging always enabled via HW; FW controls charging via I²C instead; ship mode entered by... never via CD — then R4's purpose (avoid dead-board ship mode) is served and FW loses nothing it can't do over I²C except forcing ship). Hmm — F-series spec (OD-8) chose GPIO+pull-up for ship-mode capability. Present (a) vs (e) to JP.

### 3.3 Conflicts, risks, firmware impact

| ID | Finding | Resolution in this spec | FW impact |
|---|---|---|---|
| C1 | **P0.24 absent** — hardware doc §10 assigns Boost EN = P0.24 (v1) / RFID_EN = P0.24 (v2) | Boost EN → **P0.17** (module pin 49). v2 RFID_EN → P0.17 likewise (or P0.06/P0.12) | `boost_en` pin change in config/overlay |
| C2 | **P0.25 absent** — hardware doc §2 assigns BQ CD = P0.25 | CD → **P0.08** (module pin 50) + 100 kΩ pull-up to V_PMID so the board always boots active (CD low + battery-only = BQ Hi-Z ship mode = dead board). See OD-8 | `bq_cd` pin change |
| C3 | **Module RESET_N = P0.18** (fixed) vs Nicla's BHI260AP RESET on P0.18 (app.overlay pulses it low at bring-up; hardware doc §2 "P0.18 → BQ25120 MR reset network") | BHI RESETN → **P0.13** (module pin 52), pull-up retained. Do **not** wire anything external to pin 12 except SWD/TP. (The Nicla's "P0.18 → BQ MR" net is dropped — MR unused on P1, see §4.1) | overlay: BHI reset-gpios 18 → 13 |
| R1 | P0.03 (SPI SCK) carries Table 4 remark "standard drive, low-frequency I/O only… avoid using these pins for high-speed digital interfaces… Digital noise on these pins can reduce radio sensitivity" — vs app.overlay's 16 MHz BHI SPI | Keep Nicla-parity routing (function locked to the proven design); mitigation documented: if RF sensitivity regressions appear in bench S03/S04, drop SPI clock (BHI works at 8/4 MHz) and re-test. Decision point at EMC/range bench — JP informed | optional `spi-max-frequency` reduction |
| R2 | P0.19 (SK6812 data, 800 kHz NZR) carries the same "low frequency I/O only" remark | Same treatment as R1; the strip is 3 mm from the antenna zone — also see §4.9 keepout. Fallback alternative: move strip to a full-drive GPIO (P0.06/P0.12) with zero Nicla-parity loss (SK6812 is an SGC peripheral, not a Nicla part) — JP call (OD-9b) | overlay pin change if moved |
| C4 | Nicla's VDDIO_EXT header rail (BQ LS/LDO, programmable 1.8–3.3 V per ABX00050 pinout) has **no consumer on P1** (no external header, no level translators) | LS/LDO unused: LSCTRL → GND (disabled), LS/LDO pin → 1 µF to GND (stability, §7 pin table), VINLS → SYS (per SLUSD08A §9.3: "If the output of the LDO is less than the programmed V(SYS) voltage, connect VINLS to SYS") | none |

## 4. Per-subsystem net lists

### 4.1 Charger subsystem — BQ25120A (YFP 25-ball DSBGA; ball map verbatim from SLUSD08A §7)

| Ball | Name | Net / connection |
|---|---|---|
| A2 | IN | VBUS_USB (USB-C VBUS) + **C_IN 1 µF** ("Bypass IN to GND with at least 1 µF") |
| A3, B3 | PMID | V_PMID + **C_PMID ≥3 µF** ("at least 3 µF… as close as possible"; Nicla uses 4.7 µF C10) → IS31FL3194 VCC, CD pull-up rail |
| A1, D5 | GND | GND |
| A5 | PGND | GND (buck hot loop; output cap to this ground per §7) |
| A4 | SW | L1 **2.2 µH** (Nicla: MLZ1608A2R2WT000) → PGND side; SYS sense |
| B5 | SYS | **+1V8 rail** + **C_SYS ≥4.7 µF** (Nicla: C15 10 µF) — buck default **1.8 V** (SYS_VOUT "1.8 V through 3.3 V selection", default per §7 table "BQ25120A Enabled 1.8 V Load Switch") |
| B1, B2 | BAT | VBAT (cell +) + **C_BAT ≥1 µF** |
| C3 | TS | NTC net: **R_HI from VBUS/driver to TS**, **R_LO TS→GND**, pack NTC (TS→GND) per Fig. 18 + Eq. 1–2. R_HI/R_LO values **TBD-JP** (need Renata NTC R25/B constants; JEITA thresholds V(COLD/COOL/WARM/HOT) per datasheet) |
| C1 | ISET | **R_ISET = 1.82 kΩ 1%** → ICHG = K(ISET)/R(ISET) = 200/1820 ≈ **110 mA** (Table 5, KISET typ 200 AΩ; task-given 110 mA) |
| C2 | ILIM | **R_ILIM = 1.0 kΩ 1%** → 200 mA (Table 4 row "0.19/0.2/0.21 A — 1000 Ω") |
| D1 | IPRETERM | **4.99 kΩ** → termination/pre-charge = 10 % of ISET ≈ 11 mA (Table 3 row 10 % → 4990 Ω) |
| D2 | INT | open-drain status → 100 kΩ pull-up to +1V8 → **NC on MCU** (charging bit read from FAULTS reg over I²C, per AD-029 firmware note); TP |
| D3 | RESET | NC (BQ's MR-reset output unused on P1 — Nicla's "P0.18→MR" net dropped, see C3) |
| D4 | /PG | TP only (optional 100 kΩ pull-up to +1V8) |
| E1 | /MR | NC (internal logic handles; ship mode via I²C/CD per OD-8 decision) |
| E2 | /CD | **P0.08** (module pin 50) + **100 kΩ pull-up to V_PMID** — pull-up guarantees active mode at cold boot (CD has internal 900 kΩ pull-down; CD low + battery-only = Hi-Z). OD-8 |
| E3 | LSCTRL | GND (LS/LDO disabled — no consumer, C4) |
| E4 | SDA | &i2c0 SDA (P0.15) |
| E5 | SCL | &i2c0 SCL (P0.16) |

| C5 | LS/LDO | 1 µF to GND, otherwise NC |

VBATREG note: default register = **4.2 V** (§7 table "4.2 V" battery-regulation default; VBREG equation "VBATREG = 3.6 V + VBREGCODE × 10 mV", charge range 3.6–4.65 V) — correct for the cell; no divider/resistor needed.

**Note (OD-12):** verify MAX17048 VIH accepts 1.8 V pull-ups with VDD=VBAT (datasheet fetch was bot-blocked; pin table above is from the ADI datasheet text). BQ25120A VIH = 0.825 V and IS31FL3194 VIH ≤ 1.4 V are already 1.8 V-safe.

### 4.3 RGB LED (Nicla stock) + SK6812 strip (SGC)

**IS31FL3194-CLS2-TR (WLCSP-8)** + ROHM **SMLP34RGB2W3** LED (exact Nicla BOM, ABX00050 schematic U8/DL1):

| IS31 pin (datasheet Pin Description) | Connection |
|---|---|
| A1 SDB | "Shutdown the chip when pulled to low" → **V_PMID** (always-enabled; control via I²C) — Nicla SDB net **TBD-JP** (confirm on ABX00050 schematic at capture; do not guess) |
| A2 VCC | **V_PMID** (Nicla parity: U8 powered from PMID; IS31 VCC range 2.7–5.5 V covers 3.0–5.0 V battery/input) + 0.1 µF (value **TBD-JP** — typical-app figure is graphical; confirm vs Lumissil EVB/Nicla) |
| B1 SDA / C1 SCL | &i2c0 (P0.15/P0.16) — fixed 7-bit address **"101 0011" = 0x53**, no strap pins |
| B2/C2/D2 OUT1–OUT3 | SMLP34RGB2W3 R/G/B anodes (current-sink outputs; no resistors) |
| D1 GND | GND |

**SK6812-mini ×5** (SGC strip, P0.19): DIN ← P0.19 **through a 5 V-logic level translator** (boost rail is 5 V; SK6812 VIH ≈ 0.7·VDD — 1.8 V drive is insufficient). ## 5. Power tree with currents

```
USB-C 5 V ──IN── BQ25120A ──BAT── Renata 600 mAh (3.7 V, NTC 3-wire, JST-3)
   │               │  │ILIM 200 mA      │
   │               │  └ ICHG 110 mA     ├─► MAX17048 VDD (3 µA hibernate typ — AD-029)
   │               │                    └─► (nothing else on VBAT)
   │               ├─PMID──► IS31FL3194 VCC (≤ 3×10 mA LED band, I2C-set)
   │               └─SYS = +1V8 (300 mA buck max) ──► B402 VCC (module DC/DC int.)
   │                                            ──► BHI cluster + U2 + U7 (≤ ~15 mA active)
   │                                            ──► I²C pull-ups, Y1 osc
   └─(via boost, battery-side) MT3608 ── +5V ──► SK6812 ×5 (anim ~8–15 mA; 60 mA worst)
```

- System peaks: BLE TX peak handled by B402's internal DC/DC (datasheet §2.1.1: integrated step-down; battery must handle module peak per SIM §3.4.1); BQ buck 300 mA ceiling ≫ our ~25 mA ARMED/LOGGING budget (hardware doc §7 power table).
- Charge + system simultaneously: 110 mA (ICHG) + ~25 mA (system) + LEDs ~15 mA @5V→~23 mA battery-side ≈ 158 mA < ILIM 200 mA ✓ (with USB present the buck loads are served from VIN via power path, per BQ §9.3 DPPM description).
- Session budget unchanged from hardware doc §7 (~48 mAh/session → ~12.5 sessions @ 20 °C; gauge adds ~3 µA — AD-029).
- Battery capacity: docs say **Renata ICP622540PMT, 600 mAh** (sgc_system_design §746, hardware doc §7) — the task brief's "550 mAh" figure appears nowhere in the repo; **confirm OD-4**.

## 5. Power tree with currents

```
USB-C 5 V ──IN── BQ25120A ──BAT── Renata 600 mAh (3.7 V, NTC 3-wire, JST-3)
   │               │  │ILIM 200 mA      │
   │               │  └ ICHG 110 mA     ├─► MAX17048 VDD (3 µA hibernate typ — AD-029)
   │               │                    └─► (nothing else on VBAT)
   │               ├─PMID──► IS31FL3194 VCC (≤ 3×10 mA LED band, I2C-set)
   │               └─SYS = +1V8 (300 mA buck max) ──► B402 VCC (module DC/DC int.)
   │                                            ──► BHI cluster + U2 + U7 (≤ ~15 mA active)
   │                                            ──► I²C pull-ups, Y1 osc
   └─(via boost, battery-side) MT3608 ── +5V ──► SK6812 ×5 (anim ~8–15 mA; 60 mA worst)
```

- System peaks: BLE TX peak handled by B402's internal DC/DC (datasheet §2.1.1: integrated step-down; battery must handle module peak per SIM §3.4.1); BQ buck 300 mA ceiling ≫ our ~25 mA ARMED/LOGGING budget (hardware doc §7 power table).
- Charge + system simultaneously: 110 mA (ICHG) + ~25 mA (system) + LEDs ~15 mA @5V→~23 mA battery-side ≈ 158 mA < ILIM 200 mA ✓ (with USB present the buck loads are served from VIN via power path, per BQ §9.3 DPPM description).

**"Unknown" on battery is expected, not a failure of 0.25.1.** The fix cured the thing that blocked System-Off (the frozen VIN oracle); the *percentage* path is a separate, pre-existing limitation — when the BQ reports "no VIN" (bit 0x20), the code returns "unknown" *before* reaching the battery-voltage readout routine. - reads fail → 3-strike fail-safe assumes battery → System Off proceeds

3. Bonus check: app shows a fresh boot time rather than the session from tonight

If the LED is still blinking in the morning, tell me — but both code paths say it won't be. Good night 👋

Zephyr `&i2c1` = P0.22/P0.23 = sensor bus ("Wire") — LDC1612 0x2A (ADDR=GND, DNP) + RV-3028 0x52 (DNP). BHI260AP is **SPI**, not I²C (app.overlay: `&spi2`, CS P0.31, 16 MHz, INT P0.14); BMP390/BMM150/BME688 are BHI260AP **sub-sensors on the BHI's M1 master port** (Nicla schematic — the task brief's "BMP390 I²C addr" does not apply; per the ABX00050 pinout, BMP390L rides BHI M1 with MCSB). - Keepout rule (SIM Appendix B, p.70, verbatim): "It is important not to route any traces in any layer in the antenna strip clearance area." — antenna strip = module edge + counterpoise region per SIM Figures 33–36; **no traces/vias in any layer** under/around the strip; counterpoise trace per the reference design.
- Certification caution (SIM App. B): "PCB layout must be identical to that provided by u-blox… The designer must use the stack-up provided by u-blox. RF traces on the carrier PCB are part of the certified design." → our 0.8 mm 4-layer stackup must be checked against the SIM reference stackup; if it differs, follow SIM App. B exactly or contact u-blox (flag in §8).
- Board outline: 22 × 55 mm, 4-layer, 0.8 mm, ENIG (hardware doc §9). BHI260AP antenna-adjacent and BMM150 keepouts (>10 mm from coil/RFID footprints) per hardware doc §9 table. SK6812 strip along top edge; button/LED face outward (§8).
- datasheet note: "The IC should be placed far away from the mobile antenna in order to prevent the EMI" (IS31FL3194 datasheet) — keep U8 clear of the module antenna strip.

## 5. Power tree with currents

```
USB-C 5 V ──IN── BQ25120A ──BAT── Renata 600 mAh (3.7 V, NTC 3-wire, JST-3)
   │               │  │ILIM 200 mA      │
   │               │  └ ICHG 110 mA     ├─► MAX17048 VDD (3 µA hibernate typ — AD-029)
   │               │                    └─► (nothing else on VBAT)
   │               ├─PMID──► IS31FL3194 VCC (≤ 3×10 mA LED band, I2C-set)
   │               └─SYS = +1V8 (300 mA buck max) ──► B402 VCC (module DC/DC int.)
   │                                            ──► BHI cluster + U2 + U7 (≤ ~15 mA active)
   │                                            ──► I²C pull-ups, Y1 osc
   └─(via boost, battery-side) MT3608 ── +5V ──► SK6812 ×5 (anim ~8–15 mA; 60 mA worst)
```

- System peaks: BLE TX peak handled by B402's internal DC/DC (datasheet §2.1.1: integrated step-down; battery must handle module peak per SIM §3.4.1); BQ buck 300 mA ceiling ≫ our ~25 mA ARMED/LOGGING budget (hardware doc §7 power table).
- Charge + system simultaneously: 110 mA (ICHG) + ~25 mA (system) + LEDs ~15 mA @5V→~23 mA battery-side ≈ 158 mA < ILIM 200 mA ✓ (with USB present the buck loads are served from VIN via power path, per BQ §9.3 DPPM description).
- Session budget unchanged from hardware doc §7 (~48 mAh/session → ~12.5 sessions @ 20 °C; gauge adds ~3 µA — AD-029).
- Battery capacity: docs say **Renata ICP622540PMT, 600 mAh** (sgc_system_design §746, hardware doc §7) — the task brief's "550 mAh" figure appears nowhere in the repo; **confirm OD-4**.

## 5. Power tree with currents

```
USB-C 5 V ──IN── BQ25120A ──BAT── Renata 600 mAh (3.7 V, NTC 3-wire, JST-3)
   │               │  │ILIM 200 mA      │
   │               │  └ ICHG 110 mA     ├─► MAX17048 VDD (3 µA hibernate typ — AD-029)
   │               │                    └─► (nothing else on VBAT)
   │               ├─PMID──► IS31FL3194 VCC (≤ 3×10 mA LED band, I2C-set)
   │               └─SYS = +1V8 (300 mA buck max) ──► B402 VCC (module DC/DC int.)
   │                                            ──► BHI cluster + U2 + U7 (≤ ~15 mA active)
   │                                            ──► I²C pull-ups, Y1 osc
   └─(via boost, battery-side) MT3608 ── +5V ──► SK6812 ×5 (anim ~8–15 mA; 60 mA worst)
```

- System peaks: BLE TX peak handled by B402's internal DC/DC (datasheet §2.1.1: integrated step-down; battery must handle module peak per SIM §3.4.1); BQ buck 300 mA ceiling ≫ our ~25 mA ARMED/LOGGING budget (hardware doc §7 power table).
- Charge + system simultaneously: 110 mA (ICHG) + ~25 mA (system) + LEDs ~15 mA @5V→~23 mA battery-side ≈ 158 mA < ILIM 200 mA ✓ (with USB present the buck loads are served from VIN via power path, per BQ §9.3 DPPM description).
- Session budget unchanged from hardware doc §7 (~48 mAh/session → ~12.5 sessions @ 20 °C; gauge adds ~3 µA — AD-029).
- Battery capacity: docs say **Renata ICP622540PMT, 600 mAh** (sgc_system_design §746, hardware doc §7) — the task brief's "550 mAh" figure appears nowhere in the repo; **confirm OD-4**.

9.3.16 External NTC Monitoring (TS) 

The I 2C interface allows the user to easily implement the JEITA standard for systems where the battery pack thermistor is monitored by the host. Additionally, the device provides a flexible voltage based TS input for monitoring the battery pack NTC thermistor. The voltage at TS is monitored to determine that the battery is at a safe temperature during charging. To satisfy the JEITA requirements, four temperature thresholds are monitored: the cold battery threshold, the cool battery threshold, the warm battery threshold, and the hot battery threshold. These temperatures correspond to the V (COLD) , V (COOL) , V (WARM) , and V (HOT) threshold in the Electrical Characteristics . Charging and timers are suspended when V (TS) < V (HOT) or > V (COLD) . When V (COOL) < V (TS) < V (COLD) , the charging current is reduced to half of the programmed charge current. When V (HOT) < V (TS) < V (WARM) , the battery regulation voltage is reduced by 140 mV (minimum V BATREG under this condition is 3.6V). The TS function is voltage based for maximum flexibility. Connect a resistor divider from V IN to GND with TS connected to the center tap to set the threshold. The connections are shown in Figure 18. 9.3.16 External NTC Monitoring (TS) 

The I 2C interface allows the user to easily implement the JEITA standard for systems where the battery pack thermistor is monitored by the host. Additionally, the device provides a flexible voltage based TS input for monitoring the battery pack NTC thermistor. The voltage at TS is monitored to determine that the battery is at a safe temperature during charging. To satisfy the JEITA requirements, four temperature thresholds are monitored: the cold battery threshold, the cool battery threshold, the warm battery threshold, and the hot battery threshold. These temperatures correspond to the V (COLD) , V (COOL) , V (WARM) , and V (HOT) threshold in the Electrical Characteristics . Charging and timers are suspended when V (TS) < V (HOT) or > V (COLD) . When V (COOL) < V (TS) < V (COLD) , the charging current is reduced to half of the programmed charge current. When V (HOT) < V (TS) < V (WARM) , the battery regulation voltage is reduced by 140 mV (minimum V BATREG under this condition is 3.6V). The TS function is voltage based for maximum flexibility. Connect a resistor divider from V IN to GND with TS connected to the center tap to set the threshold. The connections are shown in Figure 18. High_Level_Requirements/system_design/architecture_modules/sgc_bom.md:85:- nRF52832 (ANNA-B112 module), BHI260AP, BMP390, BMM150, BME688 — already on Nicla. **Custom-board radio module: ANNA-B402** (nRF52833, decided 2026-09-10 — supersedes B112/B412 evaluations); add to the module line-item at the next BOM revision
High_Level_Requirements/system_design/architecture_modules/sgc_schematic_spec.md:34:P1 **standalone custom PCB** (first non-Nicla hardware spin), based on the **u-blox ANNA-B402** open-CPU module (nRF52833) per **AD-019** — no companion-carrier phase. The board is a **strict replica of the proven Nicla Sense ME sensor set** (BHI260AP + BMM150 + BMP390L + BME688 + dual MX25R flash + IS31FL3194 RGB + BQ25120A power) with the SGC deltas:
High_Level_Requirements/system_design/architecture_modules/sgc_schematic_spec.md:69:           ──► BHI260AP VDD/VDDIO + BMP390L + BME688 + BMM150 (Nicla cluster)
High_Level_Requirements/system_design/architecture_modules/sgc_schematic_spec.md:89:**Bus-map derivation (strict, per docs):** Zephyr `&i2c0` = P0.15/P0.16 = power-management bus ("Wire1" in Arduino naming) — gauge 0x36 (AD-029), LED 0x53, charger 0x6A. Zephyr `&i2c1` = P0.22/P0.23 = sensor bus ("Wire") — LDC1612 0x2A (ADDR=GND, DNP) + RV-3028 0x52 (DNP).
```
USB-C 5 V ──IN── BQ25120A ──BAT── Renata 600 mAh (3.7 V, NTC 3-wire, JST-3)
   │               │  │ILIM 200 mA      │
   │               │  └ ICHG 110 mA     ├─► MAX17048 VDD (3 µA hibernate typ — AD-029)
```

| C2 | **P0.25 absent** — hardware doc §2 assigns BQ CD = P0.25 | CD → **P0.08** (module pin 50) + 100 kΩ pull-up to V_PMID so the board always boots active (CD low + battery-only = BQ Hi-Z ship mode = dead board). See OD-8 | `bq_cd` pin change |

## 5. Power tree with currents

```
USB-C 5 V ──IN── BQ25120A ──BAT── Renata 600 mAh (3.7 V, NTC 3-wire, JST-3)
   │               │  │ILIM 200 mA      │
   │               │  └ ICHG 110 mA     ├─► MAX17048 VDD (3 µA hibernate typ — AD-029)
   │               │                    └─► (nothing else on VBAT)
   │               ├─PMID──► IS31FL3194 VCC (≤ 3×10 mA LED band, I2C-set)
   │               └─SYS = +1V8 (300 mA buck max) ──► B402 VCC (module DC/DC int.)
   │                                            ──► BHI cluster + U2 + U7 (≤ ~15 mA active)
   │                                            ──► I²C pull-ups, Y1 osc
   └─(via boost, battery-side) MT3608 ── +5V ──► SK6812 ×5 (anim ~8–15 mA; 60 mA worst)
```

- System peaks: BLE TX peak handled by B402's internal DC/DC (datasheet §2.1.1: integrated step-down; battery must handle module peak per SIM §3.4.1); BQ buck 300 mA ceiling ≫ our ~25 mA ARMED/LOGGING budget (hardware doc §7 power table).
- Charge + system simultaneously: 110 mA (ICHG) + ~25 mA (system) + LEDs ~15 mA @5V→~23 mA battery-side ≈ 158 mA < ILIM 200 mA ✓ (with USB present the buck loads are served from VIN via power path, per BQ §9.3 DPPM description).
- Session budget unchanged from hardware doc §7 (~48 mAh/session → ~12.5 sessions @ 20 °C; gauge adds ~3 µA — AD-029).
- Battery capacity: docs say **Renata ICP622540PMT, 600 mAh** (sgc_system_design §746, hardware doc §7) — the task brief's "550 mAh" figure appears nowhere in the repo; **confirm OD-4**.

| | ICP622540PMT (current spec) | ICP632136HPST (proposed) |
|---|---|---|

| NTC | **yes, included** | **yes, included** ✓ (your "no NTC specs" was right — *no constants printed*, but the thermistor is there) |
| Charge window | 0…45 °C | 0…45 °C |

**The HPST is the better mechanical fit and fresher product — but it's a 4.35 V cell.** Three implications: (1) firmware must set BQ25120A VBATREG to 4.35 V or you permanently undercharge it (~10–15 % capacity loss, safe but wasteful); (2) once set to 4.35 V, a 4.2 V cell must **never** be paired to the device — overcharge risk, a one-way door in config; (3) the MAX17048 gauge's LiPo model skews slightly (acceptable). If you're happy with that lock-in: **GO for HPST** and I'll set VBATREG + update the docs. If you'd rather keep 4.2 V flexibility, we hunt a same-size 4.2 V pack instead.

They land at 39.95 %/15.1 % against the 39.8 %/15.0 % thresholds — as close as E24 gets. Adding both plus your approved R4 re-top to the netlist now:

## 5. Power tree with currents

```
USB-C 5 V ──IN── BQ25120A ──BAT── Renata 600 mAh (3.7 V, NTC 3-wire, JST-3)
   │               │  │ILIM 200 mA      │
   │               │  └ ICHG 110 mA     ├─► MAX17048 VDD (3 µA hibernate typ — AD-029)
   │               │                    └─► (nothing else on VBAT)
   │               ├─PMID──► IS31FL3194 VCC (≤ 3×10 mA LED band, I2C-set)
   │               └─SYS = +1V8 (300 mA buck max) ──► B402 VCC (module DC/DC int.)
   │                                            ──► BHI cluster + U2 + U7 (≤ ~15 mA active)
   │                                            ──► I²C pull-ups, Y1 osc
   └─(via boost, battery-side) MT3608 ── +5V ──► SK6812 ×5 (anim ~8–15 mA; 60 mA worst)
```

- System peaks: BLE TX peak handled by B402's internal DC/DC (datasheet §2.1.1: integrated step-down; battery must handle module peak per SIM §3.4.1); BQ buck 300 mA ceiling ≫ our ~25 mA ARMED/LOGGING budget (hardware doc §7 power table).
- Charge + system simultaneously: 110 mA (ICHG) + ~25 mA (system) + LEDs ~15 mA @5V→~23 mA battery-side ≈ 158 mA < ILIM 200 mA ✓ (with USB present the buck loads are served from VIN via power path, per BQ §9.3 DPPM description).
- Session budget unchanged from hardware doc §7 (~48 mAh/session → ~12.5 sessions @ 20 °C; gauge adds ~3 µA — AD-029).
- Battery capacity: docs say **Renata ICP622540PMT, 600 mAh** (sgc_system_design §746, hardware doc §7) — the task brief's "550 mAh" figure appears nowhere in the repo; **confirm OD-4**.

## 5. Power tree with currents

```
USB-C 5 V ──IN── BQ25120A ──BAT── Renata 600 mAh (3.7 V, NTC 3-wire, JST-3)
   │               │  │ILIM 200 mA      │
   │               │  └ ICHG 110 mA     ├─► MAX17048 VDD (3 µA hibernate typ — AD-029)
   │               │                    └─► (nothing else on VBAT)
   │               ├─PMID──► IS31FL3194 VCC (≤ 3×10 mA LED band, I2C-set)
   │               └─SYS = +1V8 (300 mA buck max) ──► B402 VCC (module DC/DC int.)
   │                                            ──► BHI cluster + U2 + U7 (≤ ~15 mA active)
   │                                            ──► I²C pull-ups, Y1 osc
   └─(via boost, battery-side) MT3608 ── +5V ──► SK6812 ×5 (anim ~8–15 mA; 60 mA worst)
```

- System peaks: BLE TX peak handled by B402's internal DC/DC (datasheet §2.1.1: integrated step-down; battery must handle module peak per SIM §3.4.1); BQ buck 300 mA ceiling ≫ our ~25 mA ARMED/LOGGING budget (hardware doc §7 power table).
- Charge + system simultaneously: 110 mA (ICHG) + ~25 mA (system) + LEDs ~15 mA @5V→~23 mA battery-side ≈ 158 mA < ILIM 200 mA ✓ (with USB present the buck loads are served from VIN via power path, per BQ §9.3 DPPM description).
- Session budget unchanged from hardware doc §7 (~48 mAh/session → ~12.5 sessions @ 20 °C; gauge adds ~3 µA — AD-029).
- Battery capacity: docs say **Renata ICP622540PMT, 600 mAh** (sgc_system_design §746, hardware doc §7) — the task brief's "550 mAh" figure appears nowhere in the repo; **confirm OD-4**.

BMP390L: 10-pin LGA (1 VDDIO, 2 SCK, 3 VSS, 4 SDI, 5 SDO, …, CSB; CSB→VDDIO selects I²C — here SPI to BHI).

## 5. Power tree with currents

```
USB-C 5 V ──IN── BQ25120A ──BAT── Renata 600 mAh (3.7 V, NTC 3-wire, JST-3)
   │               │  │ILIM 200 mA      │
```

## 5. Power tree with currents

```
USB-C 5 V ──IN── BQ25120A ──BAT── Renata 600 mAh (3.7 V, NTC 3-wire, JST-3)
   │               │  │ILIM 200 mA      │
   │               │  └ ICHG 110 mA     ├─► MAX17048 VDD (3 µA hibernate typ — AD-029)
   │               │                    └─► (nothing else on VBAT)
   │               ├─PMID──► IS31FL3194 VCC (≤ 3×10 mA LED band, I2C-set)
   │               └─SYS = +1V8 (300 mA buck max) ──► B402 VCC (module DC/DC int.)
   │                                            ──► BHI cluster + U2 + U7 (≤ ~15 mA active)
   │                                            ──► I²C pull-ups, Y1 osc
   └─(via boost, battery-side) MT3608 ── +5V ──► SK6812 ×5 (anim ~8–15 mA; 60 mA worst)
```

- System peaks: BLE TX peak handled by B402's internal DC/DC (datasheet §2.1.1: integrated step-down; battery must handle module peak per SIM §3.4.1); BQ buck 300 mA ceiling ≫ our ~25 mA ARMED/LOGGING budget (hardware doc §7 power table).
- Charge + system simultaneously: 110 mA (ICHG) + ~25 mA (system) + LEDs ~15 mA @5V→~23 mA battery-side ≈ 158 mA < ILIM 200 mA ✓ (with USB present the buck loads are served from VIN via power path, per BQ §9.3 DPPM description).
- Session budget unchanged from hardware doc §7 (~48 mAh/session → ~12.5 sessions @ 20 °C; gauge adds ~3 µA — AD-029).
- Battery capacity: docs say **Renata ICP622540PMT, 600 mAh** (sgc_system_design §746, hardware doc §7) — the task brief's "550 mAh" figure appears nowhere in the repo; **confirm OD-4**.

## 5. Power tree with currents

```
USB-C 5 V ──IN── BQ25120A ──BAT── Renata 600 mAh (3.7 V, NTC 3-wire, JST-3)
   │               │  │ILIM 200 mA      │
   │               │  └ ICHG 110 mA     ├─► MAX17048 VDD (3 µA hibernate typ — AD-029)
   │               │                    └─► (nothing else on VBAT)
   │               ├─PMID──► IS31FL3194 VCC (≤ 3×10 mA LED band, I2C-set)
   │               └─SYS = +1V8 (300 mA buck max) ──► B402 VCC (module DC/DC int.)
   │                                            ──► BHI cluster + U2 + U7 (≤ ~15 mA active)
   │                                            ──► I²C pull-ups, Y1 osc
   └─(via boost, battery-side) MT3608 ── +5V ──► SK6812 ×5 (anim ~8–15 mA; 60 mA worst)
```

- System peaks: BLE TX peak handled by B402's internal DC/DC (datasheet §2.1.1: integrated step-down; battery must handle module peak per SIM §3.4.1); BQ buck 300 mA ceiling ≫ our ~25 mA ARMED/LOGGING budget (hardware doc §7 power table).
- Charge + system simultaneously: 110 mA (ICHG) + ~25 mA (system) + LEDs ~15 mA @5V→~23 mA battery-side ≈ 158 mA < ILIM 200 mA ✓ (with USB present the buck loads are served from VIN via power path, per BQ §9.3 DPPM description).
- Session budget unchanged from hardware doc §7 (~48 mAh/session → ~12.5 sessions @ 20 °C; gauge adds ~3 µA — AD-029).
- Battery capacity: docs say **Renata ICP622540PMT, 600 mAh** (sgc_system_design §746, hardware doc §7) — the task brief's "550 mAh" figure appears nowhere in the repo; **confirm OD-4**.

### 4.1 Charger subsystem — BQ25120A (YFP 25-ball DSBGA; ball map verbatim from SLUSD08A §7)

| Ball | Name | Net / connection |
|---|---|---|
| A2 | IN | VBUS_USB (USB-C VBUS) + **C_IN 1 µF** ("Bypass IN to GND with at least 1 µF") |
| A3, B3 | PMID | V_PMID + **C_PMID ≥3 µF** ("at least 3 µF… as close as possible"; Nicla uses 4.7 µF C10) → IS31FL3194 VCC, CD pull-up rail |
| A1, D5 | GND | GND |
| A5 | PGND | GND (buck hot loop; output cap to this ground per §7) |
| A4 | SW | L1 **2.2 µH** (Nicla: MLZ1608A2R2WT000) → PGND side; SYS sense |
| B5 | SYS | **+1V8 rail** + **C_SYS ≥4.7 µF** (Nicla: C15 10 µF) — buck default **1.8 V** (SYS_VOUT "1.8 V through 3.3 V selection", default per §7 table "BQ25120A Enabled 1.8 V Load Switch") |
| B1, B2 | BAT | VBAT (cell +) + **C_BAT ≥1 µF** |
| C3 | TS | NTC net: **R_HI from VBUS/driver to TS**, **R_LO TS→GND**, pack NTC (TS→GND) per Fig. 18 + Eq. 1–2. R_HI/R_LO values **TBD-JP** (need Renata NTC R25/B constants; JEITA thresholds V(COLD/COOL/WARM/HOT) per datasheet) |
| C1 | ISET | **R_ISET = 1.82 kΩ 1%** → ICHG = K(ISET)/R(ISET) = 200/1820 ≈ **110 mA** (Table 5, KISET typ 200 AΩ; task-given 110 mA) |
| C2 | ILIM | **R_ILIM = 1.0 kΩ 1%** → 200 mA (Table 4 row "0.19/0.2/0.21 A — 1000 Ω") |
| D1 | IPRETERM | **4.99 kΩ** → termination/pre-charge = 10 % of ISET ≈ 11 mA (Table 3 row 10 % → 4990 Ω) |
| D2 | INT | open-drain status → 100 kΩ pull-up to +1V8 → **NC on MCU** (charging bit read from FAULTS reg over I²C, per AD-029 firmware note); TP |
| D3 | RESET | NC (BQ's MR-reset output unused on P1 — Nicla's "P0.18→MR" net dropped, see C3) |
| D4 | /PG | TP only (optional 100 kΩ pull-up to +1V8) |
| E1 | /MR | NC (internal logic handles; ship mode via I²C/CD per OD-8 decision) |
| E2 | /CD | **P0.08** (module pin 50) + **100 kΩ pull-up to V_PMID** — pull-up guarantees active mode at cold boot (CD has internal 900 kΩ pull-down; CD low + battery-only = Hi-Z). OD-8 |
| E3 | LSCTRL | GND (LS/LDO disabled — no consumer, C4) |
| E4 | SDA | &i2c0 SDA (P0.15) |
| E5 | SCL | &i2c0 SCL (P0.16) |
| C4, B4 | VINLS | → SYS (rule §9.3 quoted in C4) + 1 µF |
| C5 | LS/LDO | 1 µF to GND, otherwise NC |

VBATREG note: default register = **4.2 V** (§7 table "4.2 V" battery-regulation default; VBREG equation "VBATREG = 3.6 V + VBREGCODE × 10 mV", charge range 3.6–4.65 V) — correct for the cell; no divider/resistor needed.

### 4.2 Fuel gauge — MAX17048G+T10 (TDFN-8; pin functions verbatim from ADI datasheet Pin Description table)

| Pin | Name | Connection |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | CTG | GND ("Connect to Ground") |
| 2 | CELL | GND ("MAX17048: Not internally connected") |
| 3 | VDD | **VBAT** ("MAX17048: Voltage sense input. Connect to positive battery terminal") + **0.1 µF** ("Bypass with 0.1 µF to GND") |
| 4 | GND | GND ("negative battery terminal") |
| 5 | ALRT | "Open-Drain, Active-Low Alert Output" → 10 kΩ pull-up to +1V8 → **P0.21** (module pin 26). Wired for firmware freedom; use v2-optional per AD-029 |
| 6 | QSTRT | GND ("Connect to GND if not used") |
| 7 | SCL | &i2c0 SCL (P0.16) — "I2C Clock Input" (fixed addr **0x36**, per ADI datasheet/AD-029) |
| 8 | SDA | &i2c0 SDA (P0.15) |
| EP | — | GND |

**Note (OD-12):** verify MAX17048 VIH accepts 1.8 V pull-ups with VDD=VBAT (datasheet fetch was bot-blocked; pin table above is from the ADI datasheet text). BQ25120A VIH = 0.825 V and IS31FL3194 VIH ≤ 1.4 V are already 1.8 V-safe.

### 4.3 RGB LED (Nicla stock) + SK6812 strip (SGC)

**IS31FL3194-CLS2-TR (WLCSP-8)** + ROHM **SMLP34RGB2W3** LED (exact Nicla BOM, ABX00050 schematic U8/DL1):

| IS31 pin (datasheet Pin Description) | Connection |
|---|---|
| A1 SDB | "Shutdown the chip when pulled to low" → **V_PMID** (always-enabled; control via I²C) — Nicla SDB net **TBD-JP** (confirm on ABX00050 schematic at capture; do not guess) |
| A2 VCC | **V_PMID** (Nicla parity: U8 powered from PMID; IS31 VCC range 2.7–5.5 V covers 3.0–5.0 V battery/input) + 0.1 µF (value **TBD-JP** — typical-app figure is graphical; confirm vs Lumissil EVB/Nicla) |
| B1 SDA / C1 SCL | &i2c0 (P0.15/P0.16) — fixed 7-bit address **"101 0011" = 0x53**, no strap pins |
| B2/C2/D2 OUT1–OUT3 | SMLP34RGB2W3 R/G/B anodes (current-sink outputs; no resistors) |
| D1 GND | GND |

**SK6812-mini ×5** (SGC strip, P0.19): DIN ← P0.19 **through a 5 V-logic level translator** (boost rail is 5 V; SK6812 VIH ≈ 0.7·VDD — 1.8 V drive is insufficient). Dual-supply translator, VCCA=+1V8/VCCB=+5V, TXB0102/TXS0102-class — **part TBD-JP** (OD-9). Per-LED 0.1 µF; strip supply = +5V boost (hardware doc §7: full brightness for P1+).

### 4.4 Sensor cluster (Nicla replica — copy ABX00050 nets at capture)

- **BHI260AP** (44-pad LGA, 3.6×4.1×0.83 mm): HSCX pad 33 → P0.03 (SCK); HSDX pad 11 → P0.04 (MOSI); HSDO pad 32 → P0.05 (MISO); HCSB pad 34 → P0.31 (CS — "SPI mode"); HIRQ pad 10 → P0.14; **RESETN pad 9 → P0.13** (moved, C3; pad is "Input, Pull-Up, Reset input, active low"). VDD 1.71–3.6 V, **VDDIO 1.71–1.89 V** → both to +1V8 rail (this hard-pins the 1.8 V architecture — no 3.3 V sensor bus possible). Decoupling per Nicla bank: 1 µF + 100 nF ×3–4 (C5/C6/C7/C12/C13).
- **BMM150** (U4) + **BMP390L** (U3) + **BME688** (U6): sub-sensors on BHI260AP master port M1 (BMM150 SCK/SDI ← M1SCX/M1SDX; BMP390L via MCSB1; BME688 via MCSB2 per ABX00050 pinout). **Per-ball wiring = copy Nicla schematic verbatim at capture** — exact M1/M2/M3 pin assignment of the BHI cluster is a Nicla-internal net list; mark as "copy reference" in capture. BMP390L: 10-pin LGA (1 VDDIO, 2 SCK, 3 VSS, 4 SDI, 5 SDO, …, CSB; CSB→VDDIO selects I²C — here SPI to BHI).
- **BME688 populate-vs-DNP**: firmware never reads it → **OD-6** (footprint retained either way; Nicla parity = populate).
- **U2 "BHI Flash" MX25R1635FZUIH0** (Nicla U2, +1V8): BHI260AP QSPI (CLK/CS/D0–D3) — **⚠ missing from BOM v4.3** — BHY2 sensor firmware lives here (Arduino_BHY2 upload path). Must be added (OD-5).

### 4.5 Data flash — MX25R6435F (U7, SOIC-8 200 mil; pin config verbatim from Macronix v1.6)

| Pin | Name | Net |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | CS# | P0.26 (&spi2 hardware CS reg 0) |
| 2 | SO/SIO1 | P0.05 (MISO/CIPO) |
| 3 | WP#/SIO2 | NC (datasheet Note 1: "will remain internal pull up function while this pin is not physically connected") |
| 4 | GND | GND |
| 5 | SI/SIO0 | P0.04 (MOSI/COPI) |
| 6 | SCLK | P0.03 |
| 7 | RESET#/SIO3 or HOLD#/SIO3 | NC (same internal-pull-up note) |
| 8 | VCC | +1V8 + 100 nF |

RawRunStore 8 MB layout per hardware doc (pre-roll 0x0000–0x13FFF etc.) unchanged. U7 supply at +1V8 = Nicla parity (schematic shows U7 on +1V8).

### 4.6 DNP footprints (v2)

- **LDC1612** (WSON-12): SCL 1 / SDA 2 / CLKIN 3 / ADDR 4 → GND (**0x2A**, "when ADDR=L, I2C address = 0x2A") / INTB 5 → BUTTON net P0.02 ("Push-pull output; does not require pull-up") / SD 6 → GND / VDD 7 (+100 nF) / GND 8 / IN0A 9, IN0B 10 (coil ch.0; 14 mm spiral, footprint retained) / IN1A 11, IN1B 12 → GND or 2nd coil pads. Sensor-bus (&i2c1) placement per docs.
- **RV-3028-C7 RTC @ 0x52** on &i2c1: 7-pin C7 footprint, /INT → TP (unconnected test point, no GPIO steal — per hardware doc §2 I²C map + TOOLS notes). Exact pad map per Micro Crystal datasheet at capture (DNP — not fetched this pass).
